tmua-2019-p1-q1.summary: A quadratic graph has vertex $(-1,3)$ and contains $(1,-1)$. Determine its equation.
tmua-2019-p1-q1.summaryZh: 一条二次函数图像的顶点为 $(-1,3)$，且经过 $(1,-1)$。求其方程。

methods.title: Fit the vertex form
steps: The vertex fixes the form $y=a(x+1)^2+3$. At $(1,-1)$ this gives $-1=4a+3$, so $a=-1$.
Expanding $-(x+1)^2+3$ yields $-x^2-2x+2$.

tmua-2019-p1-q2.summary: For which real $k$ is $x^2+kx+2x+1-2k$ strictly positive for every real $x$?
tmua-2019-p1-q2.summaryZh: 对于哪些实数 $k$，$x^2+kx+2x+1-2k$ 对所有实数 $x$ 都严格为正？

methods.title: Exclude all real zeros
steps: The expression is an upward-opening quadratic in $x$, so it is strictly positive everywhere precisely when its discriminant is negative.
Compute $(k+2)^2-4(1-2k)=k^2+12k=k(k+12)$. The product is negative between its two roots, giving $-12<k<0$.
stepsZh: 该式是关于 $x$ 的开口向上的二次式，处处严格为正恰好等价于判别式为负。

tmua-2019-p1-q3.summaryZh: 求 $\sum_{j=0}^{80}(1+x)^j$ 中一次项 $x$ 的系数。

methods.title: Sum the individual linear coefficients
methods.titleZh: 将各项的一次系数相加
steps: For $j\ge1$, obtaining a single $x$ from $(1+x)^j$ means choosing one of its $j$ factors, so its coefficient is $j$. The constant summand at $j=0$ contributes nothing.
The total coefficient is $1+2+\cdots+80=80\cdot81/2=3240$.
stepsZh: 对于 $j\ge1$，从 $(1+x)^j$ 中取得一次项，只需在 $j$ 个括号中选择一个提供 $x$，故系数为 $j$。$j=0$ 时为常数，无贡献。

methods.title: Sum a geometric polynomial
steps: Let $S(x)=\sum_{j=0}^{80}(1+x)^j$. Multiplying by $x=(1+x)-1$ telescopes the sum to $xS(x)=(1+x)^{81}-1$.
The coefficient of $x$ in $S(x)$ equals the coefficient of $x^2$ in the right-hand side, which is $\binom{81}{2}=3240$.
stepsZh: $S(x)$ 的一次项系数即右边的二次项系数，等于 $\binom{81}{2}=3240$。

tmua-2019-p1-q4.summary: A sequence starts at $x_1=10$ and each new term is the square root of its predecessor. Express $x_{100}$ as a single power of $10$.
tmua-2019-p1-q4.summaryZh: 数列满足 $x_1=10$，每一项都是前一项的算术平方根。把 $x_{100}$ 写成以 $10$ 为底的幂。

methods.title: Track the exponent
steps: Write $x_n=10^{e_n}$. Taking a square root halves the exponent, so $e_1=1$ and $e_{n+1}=e_n/2$.
The step from term $1$ to term $100$ uses $99$ halvings, giving $e_{100}=1/2^{99}$.
stepsZh: 写作 $x_n=10^{e_n}$。每取一次平方根，指数减半，因此 $e_1=1$ 且 $e_{n+1}=e_n/2$。

tmua-2019-p1-q5.summary: A real geometric sequence has $S_6=9S_3$, where $S_j$ is the sum of the first $j$ terms. Its seventh term is $360$. Find its initial term.
tmua-2019-p1-q5.summaryZh: 实等比数列的前 $j$ 项和记为 $S_j$，已知 $S_6=9S_3$，第七项为 $360$。求首项。

methods.title: Compare two blocks of three
steps: For ratio $r$ the second block of three is $r^3$ times the first, hence $S_6=(1+r^3)S_3$. If the initial term is $a$, then $S_3=a(1+r+r^2)\ne0$: the seventh term is nonzero and $1+r+r^2=(r+1/2)^2+3/4>0$.
Cancel $S_3$ to get $r^3=8$, or $r=2$. The seventh term is $ar^6=64a=360$, giving $a=45/8$.
stepsZh: 公比为 $r$ 时，第二组三项是第一组三项分别乘 $r^3$，故 $S_6=(1+r^3)S_3$。设首项为 $a$，则 $S_3=a(1+r+r^2)\ne0$：第七项非零，且 $1+r+r^2=(r+1/2)^2+3/4>0$。

tmua-2019-p1-q6.summary: Circles centred at $(-4,-1)$ and $(8,4)$ have radii $8$ and $r>0$ respectively. They meet in exactly one point. Find the difference between the two possible radii $r$.
tmua-2019-p1-q6.summaryZh: 两圆的圆心分别为 $(-4,-1)$ 和 $(8,4)$，半径分别为 $8$ 和 $r>0$。它们只有一个公共点。求两个可能的 $r$ 值之差。

methods.title: Separate internal and external tangency
steps: The centre distance is $\sqrt{12^2+5^2}=13$. External tangency gives $8+r=13$, so $r=5$.
Internal tangency requires $|r-8|=13$. Its positive solution is $r=21$. The two radii differ by $21-5=16$.

tmua-2019-p1-q7.summary: For $y=(2q-x^2)(2qx+3)$, choose $q$ to minimise the slope at $x=-1$.
tmua-2019-p1-q7.summaryZh: 设 $y=(2q-x^2)(2qx+3)$。取何值 $q$ 能使曲线在 $x=-1$ 处的斜率最小？

methods.title: Differentiate first, then minimise in the parameter
methods.titleZh: 先对横坐标求导再对参数求最值
steps: By the product rule $y'=-2x(2qx+3)+2q(2q-x^2)$. At $x=-1$ the slope is $4q^2-6q+6$.
This upward quadratic has its vertex at $q=6/8=3/4$, so that parameter gives the least slope.
stepsZh: 该二次式开口向上，顶点对应 $q=6/8=3/4$，故此时斜率最小。

tmua-2019-p1-q8.summary: For $0<f<1$ on $[0,1]$, a fixed equal-strip trapezium rule underestimates the integral of $f$. Which transformation guarantees an overestimate with the same strip count: add one, double, translate or reflect the interval with the graph, or take $1-f$?
tmua-2019-p1-q8.summaryZh: 在 $[0,1]$ 上有 $0<f<1$，用固定等分数的梯形法估算 $f$ 的积分时得到低估值。保持分段数，哪种变换必使估值变成高估：加一、加倍、将图像连同区间平移或左右反射、或取 $1-f$？

methods.title: Use linearity of the estimate and the integral
methods.titleZh: 利用估值和积分的线性
steps: Write the trapezium sum as $T(f)$ and the true integral as $I(f)$, so $T(f)<I(f)$. The rule integrates the constant $1$ exactly on the unit interval.
Therefore $T(1-f)=1-T(f)>1-I(f)=I(1-f)$. Adding a constant, doubling, or reordering the same strips through a horizontal transformation preserves the original underestimation.
stepsZh: 设梯形估值为 $T(f)$，真实积分为 $I(f)$，则 $T(f)<I(f)$。在单位区间上，梯形法对常数 $1$ 给出的值恰为 $1$。
因此 $T(1-f)=1-T(f)>1-I(f)=I(1-f)$。加常数、正倍数缩放，或通过水平变换重新排列相同的分段，都不会改变原先低估的方向。

tmua-2019-p1-q9.summary: For $p>0$, determine the area enclosed by $y=p\sqrt{x}$ and $x=p\sqrt{y}$.
tmua-2019-p1-q9.summaryZh: 设 $p>0$，求曲线 $y=p\sqrt{x}$ 与 $x=p\sqrt{y}$ 围成的面积。

methods.title: Integrate between the two graphs
steps: The second curve is $y=x^2/p^2$ with $x\ge0$. The curves meet at $x=0$ and $x=p^2$, from $p\sqrt{x}=x^2/p^2$. The square-root curve is above the other in between.
Integrating yields $\left[(2p/3)x^{3/2}-x^3/(3p^2)\right]_0^{p^2}=2p^4/3-p^4/3=p^4/3$.
stepsZh: 第二条曲线可写作 $y=x^2/p^2$，其中 $x\ge0$。由 $p\sqrt{x}=x^2/p^2$ 得两个交点的横坐标为 $0,p^2$，两者之间根号曲线在上方。

methods.title: Use reflection in the diagonal of a square
methods.titleZh: 利用正方形对角线的反射
steps: The curves are reflections in $y=x$ and meet at the opposite corners of the square $[0,p^2]\times[0,p^2]$. The area under the lower curve in the square is $\int_0^{p^2} x^2/p^2\,dx=p^4/3$.
Reflection takes the region under that lower curve to the region above the upper curve. Removing these two equal regions from the square of area $p^4$ leaves $p^4-2p^4/3=p^4/3$.
stepsZh: 两条曲线关于 $y=x$ 对称，在正方形 $[0,p^2]\times[0,p^2]$ 的两个相对顶点处相交。方形中下方曲线以下的面积为 $\int_0^{p^2} x^2/p^2\,dx=p^4/3$。
沿对角线反射，这块区域正好变为上方曲线以上的区域。从面积 $p^4$ 的正方形中扣除两块相等区域，余下 $p^4-2p^4/3=p^4/3$。

methods.title: Split where the absolute value changes
steps: For $-1\le x\le0$, the integrand equals $-x+x^2$, giving integral $5/6$.
For $0\le x\le3$, it equals $x-x^2$, giving $9/2-9=-9/2$. The total is $5/6-9/2=-11/3$.
stepsZh: 在 $-1\le x\le0$ 时，被积函数为 $-x+x^2$，积分为 $5/6$。

tmua-2019-p1-q11.summary: Find the sum of all distinct $x$ arising in solutions of $\log_3(xy^2)=1$ and $(\log_3x)(\log_3y)=-3$.
tmua-2019-p1-q11.summaryZh: 联立 $\log_3(xy^2)=1$ 和 $(\log_3x)(\log_3y)=-3$，求所有不同 $x$ 值的和。

methods.title: Use logarithmic coordinates
steps: Let $u=\log_3x$ and $v=\log_3y$. Then $u+2v=1$ and $uv=-3$. Replacing $v$ by $(1-u)/2$ gives $u^2-u-6=0$.
The roots are $u=3,-2$, giving $x=27,1/9$. Each has a real $v$, hence a positive $y$. Their sum is $27+1/9$.
stepsZh: 解得 $u=3,-2$，对应 $x=27,1/9$。二者均有实数 $v$，从而给出正的 $y$，故所求和为 $27+1/9$。

tmua-2019-p1-q12.summary: For $t\ge1$, a quantity satisfies $V'(t)=24\pi(t-1)/(1+\sqrt{t})$ and $V(1)=7$. Find $V(9)$.

methods.title: Factor before integrating
steps: Factor $t-1=(\sqrt{t}-1)(\sqrt{t}+1)$, so $V'(t)=24\pi(\sqrt{t}-1)$.
The total change equals $24\pi[(2/3)t^{3/2}-t]_1^9=24\pi(9+1/3)=224\pi$. Add the initial value $7$.

tmua-2019-p1-q13.summary: What is the largest value of $4^{\sin x}-4\cdot2^{\sin x}+17/4$ for real $x$?
tmua-2019-p1-q13.summaryZh: 当 $x$ 遍历实数时，求 $4^{\sin x}-4\cdot2^{\sin x}+17/4$ 的最大值。

methods.title: Maximise a square on a restricted interval
methods.titleZh: 在限定区间内最大化平方项
steps: Put $u=2^{\sin x}$. Since $-1\le\sin x\le1$, its range is $[1/2,2]$. The expression becomes $(u-2)^2+1/4$.
The farthest admissible $u$ from $2$ is $1/2$, attained when $\sin x=-1$. The maximum is $(3/2)^2+1/4=5/2$.

tmua-2019-p1-q14.summary: For $0^\circ\le x\le360^\circ$, solve $\sin2x+\sqrt3\cos2x=-1$ and $\sqrt3\sin2x-\cos2x=\sqrt3$ simultaneously, and sum the solutions.
tmua-2019-p1-q14.summaryZh: 在 $0^\circ\le x\le360^\circ$ 内联立 $\sin2x+\sqrt3\cos2x=-1$、$\sqrt3\sin2x-\cos2x=\sqrt3$，求所有解之和。

methods.title: Solve for sine and cosine first
steps: Add the first equation to $\sqrt3$ times the second. This gives $4\sin2x=2$, whence $\sin2x=1/2$. Substitution gives $\cos2x=-\sqrt3/2$.
For $0^\circ\le2x\le720^\circ$, the angles with this pair are $150^\circ$ and $510^\circ$. Thus $x=75^\circ,255^\circ$, summing to $330^\circ$.
stepsZh: 第一式加上第二式的 $\sqrt3$ 倍，得 $4\sin2x=2$，所以 $\sin2x=1/2$。代回得 $\cos2x=-\sqrt3/2$。
在 $0^\circ\le2x\le720^\circ$ 中，满足这组正余弦值的角为 $150^\circ$ 与 $510^\circ$。故 $x=75^\circ,255^\circ$，其和为 $330^\circ$。

methods.title: Combine the equations with an angle shift
methods.titleZh: 用角度平移合并两个条件
steps: Put $v=2x+60^\circ$. The sine addition formula turns the first left-hand side into $2\sin v$, and the cosine addition formula turns the second into $-2\cos v$.
Thus $\sin v=-1/2$ and $\cos v=-\sqrt3/2$, so $v=210^\circ$ modulo $360^\circ$. In the stated interval this gives $x=75^\circ$ and $255^\circ$, with sum $330^\circ$.
stepsZh: 令 $v=2x+60^\circ$。由正弦和角公式，第一式左边等于 $2\sin v$；由余弦和角公式，第二式左边等于 $-2\cos v$。
于是 $\sin v=-1/2$、$\cos v=-\sqrt3/2$，故 $v$ 与 $210^\circ$ 相差 $360^\circ$ 的整数倍。在指定区间内得 $x=75^\circ,255^\circ$，和为 $330^\circ$。

tmua-2019-p1-q15.summary: Find the nonzero real solution of $2^{9^x}/8^{3^x}=1/4$.

methods.title: Compare the exponents of two
methods.titleZh: 比较底数为二的幂的指数
steps: Let $u=3^x>0$, so $9^x=u^2$. The given ratio is $2^{u^2-3u}=2^{-2}$.
Hence $(u-1)(u-2)=0$. The first root gives $x=0$, which is excluded; $u=2$ yields $x=\log_3 2$.
stepsZh: 可得 $(u-1)(u-2)=0$。第一根给出需排除的 $x=0$，而 $u=2$ 给出 $x=\log_3 2$。

tmua-2019-p1-q16.summary: Suppose $2\int_0^1 f(x)\,dx+5\int_1^2 f(x)\,dx=14$ and $\int_0^1 f(x+1)\,dx=6$. Find $\int_0^2 f(x)\,dx$.

methods.title: Shift an integration interval
steps: Substitute $u=x+1$ in the second integral. Its bounds become $1,2$, so $\int_1^2 f(u)\,du=6$.
Write $A=\int_0^1 f$. The first relation gives $2A+30=14$, whence $A=-8$. The whole integral is $-8+6=-2$.
stepsZh: 在第二个积分中令 $u=x+1$，上下限变为 $1,2$，所以 $\int_1^2f(u)\,du=6$。

tmua-2019-p1-q17.summaryZh: 在 $[0,\pi]$ 上，满足 $(\sin(2\theta)-1/2)(\sin\theta-\cos\theta)\ge0$ 的部分占区间长度的几分之几？

methods.title: Match the signs of the two factors
steps: The first factor is positive on $(\pi/12,5\pi/12)$ and negative elsewhere apart from its two zeros. The second switches from negative to positive at $\pi/4$.
The product is nonnegative on $[0,\pi/12]\cup[\pi/4,5\pi/12]$. The combined length is $\pi/12+2\pi/12=\pi/4$, one quarter of the interval.
stepsZh: 第一个因子在 $(\pi/12,5\pi/12)$ 为正，在两端点为零，其余处为负。第二个因子在 $\pi/4$ 处由负变正。
乘积非负的区间是 $[0,\pi/12]\cup[\pi/4,5\pi/12]$。总长度为 $\pi/12+2\pi/12=\pi/4$，占原区间的四分之一。

tmua-2019-p1-q18.summary: Find the minimum distance from a point on $y=x^2+4$ to a point on $y=2x-2$.
tmua-2019-p1-q18.summaryZh: 求曲线 $y=x^2+4$ 上一点与直线 $y=2x-2$ 上一点之间的最短距离。

methods.title: Minimise the point-to-line distance
methods.titleZh: 最小化点到直线的距离
steps: The distance from $(t,t^2+4)$ to the line $2x-y-2=0$ is $|2t-(t^2+4)-2|/\sqrt5$. Its numerator simplifies to $(t-1)^2+5$.
The numerator attains its minimum $5$ at $t=1$, and the perpendicular foot lies on the line. Thus the smallest distance is $5/\sqrt5=\sqrt5$.
stepsZh: 在 $t=1$ 处分子最小为 $5$，且垂足位于所给直线上。因此最短距离是 $5/\sqrt5=\sqrt5$。

methods.title: Cancel full cycles of four
steps: In any four consecutive terms the third is the negative of the first, and the fourth is the negative of the second. Thus each four-term block sums to zero.
Of the $91$ terms, $88$ form complete blocks. The final three have values $\sin10^\circ,\sin100^\circ,-\sin10^\circ$, leaving $\sin100^\circ$.
stepsZh: 任意连续四项中，第三项与第一项互为相反数，第四项与第二项互为相反数，故每四项之和为零。
共 $91$ 项，其中 $88$ 项组成完整周期。最后三项的值为 $\sin10^\circ,\sin100^\circ,-\sin10^\circ$，合计 $\sin100^\circ$。

tmua-2019-p1-q20.summary: For which $k$ do $y=x^3-12x$ and $y=k-(x-2)^2$ have three distinct intersections with exactly two positive abscissas?
tmua-2019-p1-q20.summaryZh: 对于哪些 $k$，$y=x^3-12x$ 与 $y=k-(x-2)^2$ 有三个不同交点，且恰有两个交点的横坐标为正？

methods.title: Count positive crossings first
methods.titleZh: 先计算正半轴上的交点
steps: Equating the graphs gives $k=h(x)=x^3+x^2-16x+4$. Its derivative is $(3x+8)(x-2)$. On the positive axis $h$ decreases from $h(0)=4$ to $h(2)=-16$, then strictly increases without bound.

A level crosses both positive branches strictly inside them exactly for $-16<k<4$. For these levels $h(0)>k$ while $h(x)$ tends to negative infinity to the left, so there is a negative root too. A cubic has at most three distinct roots.
stepsZh: 联立得 $k=h(x)=x^3+x^2-16x+4$，导数为 $(3x+8)(x-2)$。在正半轴上，$h$ 先从 $h(0)=4$ 降至 $h(2)=-16$，再严格递增至正无穷。
水平线在两段正半轴分支的内部各交一次，恰需 $-16<k<4$。此时 $h(0)>k$，而向左 $h(x)$ 趋于负无穷，故还存在一个负根。三次方程至多有三个不同根。
